verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an Identity Verification API with a /identity_verification/retry endpoint for programmatic re-checks, and STATUS_UPDATED and RETRIED webhook events that let an agent track outcomes. An official Plaid MCP server is also documented, but the evidence does not show it covers IDV operations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of session-create and get/list endpoints for polling and retrieving extracted data, documented scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents, confirmation that the MCP server exposes IDV pipeline tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the verification pipeline — create sessions, poll outcomes, retrieve extracted data, and trigger re-checks through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: /identity_verification/retry | Allow a user to retry an identity verification
For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
official MCP server documented at https://plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/
